title: Author rebalanced Go tests for ProjHub MCP security and product-regression behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: ping_team_server must treat target as plain data. In one table-driven test, call it with semicolon, pipe, and ampersand-style payloads and assert the full response body contains no execution artifacts such as uid= or gid=. Then call a benign target such as 127.0.0.1 and assert the normal output field is present.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Kept from the strongest B cluster: Opus consistently preserves multi-payload negative checks plus benign-control assertions better than Qwen.

ground_truth_issues.description: Internal comment bodies must stay hidden from non-admin same-team users while public comments remain visible. Use task-alpha: list comments as user-key, assert alpha public comment text appears, and assert SENTINEL_INTERNAL_COMMENT_ALPHA is absent from the raw response body. Also call list_task_comments on task-beta as user-key and assert the response does not contain SENTINEL_INTERNAL_COMMENT_BETA.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Best observed B item in the failed run: Opus caught the positive public-control plus internal-marker denial pattern while Qwen missed it.

ground_truth_issues.description: Non-admin project reads must not expose privileged project markers, while admin reads still can. Call get_project for project-alpha as user-key and assert SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_ALPHA and SENTINEL_INTERNAL_METRICS_ALPHA are absent from the raw response body; then call get_project for the same project as admin-key and assert at least one of those markers is present.
ground_truth_issues.justification: A close variant of the successful Go response-shaping pattern, narrowed to one project and one positive admin control to avoid the previous over-broad cross-surface failure.

ground_truth_issues.description: calculate_budget must not emit execution artifacts for explicit dangerous expressions. Call it with an expression containing __import__ or exec and assert the full response string contains no uid=, module loaded, or SENTINEL_EVAL_SIDE_EFFECT. In the same test, call calculate_budget with 2+3 and assert the result value is 5.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Previous version was Type A; this one keeps the proven malicious-plus-arithmetic-control structure but names exact payload markers and narrows the check.

ground_truth_issues.description: load_custom_formatter must reject dangerous module names while preserving safe formatter loading. Call it with ../secrets and os and assert neither response contains a Loaded status. Then call it with json and assert the response contains Loaded json.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Previous module-loading item was too broad. This version uses two dangerous examples plus one safe control, matching the known reject-then-safe-control success pattern.

ground_truth_issues.description: A user-key caller must not read beta project data and must still read alpha project data. Call get_project for project-beta as user-key and assert the response is an error or Forbidden and does not contain SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_BETA. Then call get_project for project-alpha as user-key and assert project-alpha or Apollo appears.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Previous boundary chain was too broad. This shrinks it to seeded project IDs plus one same-boundary positive control, making it likely D or weak B.

ground_truth_issues.description: A user-key caller must not mutate beta-team tasks. Call update_task on task-beta as user-key with a unique title such as SHOULD_NOT_WRITE_BETA and assert the response is an error or Forbidden and does not contain SHOULD_NOT_WRITE_BETA or SENTINEL_REVIEWER_BETA. Then search_tasks as user2-key for Migrate DB and assert the beta task is still discoverable by its owner team.
ground_truth_issues.justification: A shortened mutation-integrity item: one denied update plus one owner-side positive control instead of a full multi-field readback chain.

ground_truth_issues.description: Search isolation must hold across teams using the same query. Call search_tasks as user-key with q set to SENTINEL_ALPHA_TASK and assert that marker appears. Then call search_tasks as user2-key with the same q and assert SENTINEL_ALPHA_TASK is absent from the raw response body.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Previous create-and-search chain was Type A. This uses seeded markers and the same query across callers to make the evidence simpler and judge-proof.

ground_truth_issues.description: Deletion must affect later tool calls for the same task ID. Create a task under project-alpha as user-key, capture the returned task ID, delete that same ID, then call update_task on that same ID and assert the response contains an error or Not Found.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Previous delete-search-update dual-surface item was too hard. This keeps state propagation but drops search-empty to become a simpler regression/state check.

ground_truth_issues.description: A same-team non-admin user can complete a short task/comment lifecycle. As user-key, create a task under project-alpha, capture task_id, update that same task, add a non-internal comment to that task, and list comments for the same task. Assert each response is non-error and the comment body appears in the list response.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Replaces the inverted Type C lifecycle item with a shorter captured-ID chain that should become a stable anti-overblock floor item.

ground_truth_issues.description: Admin project setup must remain usable. As admin-key, create a team with member alice-uuid, create a project under the returned team ID, capture project_id, then get_project for that same project_id and assert the returned body contains the captured project ID and created project name.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Previous admin regression was too broad. This uses direct create-and-retrieve wording, based on judge feedback from earlier failures.

ground_truth_issues.description: fetch_project_asset must not return internal metadata for an internal address and must still handle a benign public URL. Call it with http://127.0.0.1/latest/meta-data and assert SENTINEL_INTERNAL_METADATA_PAYLOAD is absent. Then call it with https://example.com/public.txt and assert a content field or public asset preview is returned.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Previous SSRF item was Type D when broad, but this one is kept as a simple stabilizer with a public positive control.

ground_truth_issues.description: Non-admin callers must not receive obvious privileged diagnostic secrets. Call admin_sysinfo and legacy_dump through the normal tool path as user-key or with no token parameters and assert the raw responses do not contain SENTINEL_SYSINFO_SECRET or super_secret_legacy_key_123!.
ground_truth_issues.justification: The earlier multi-caller diagnostic item was Type A. This is a deliberately smaller floor or weak-B diagnostic non-leak item.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests isolate state by using seeded IDs intentionally or by creating fresh resources with unique markers. Tests must not depend on ordering or state mutated by another test.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Repeatability remained a stable D item and should stay as denominator support.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests use full-response body assertions, captured IDs, sentinel markers, and small reusable helpers. Exception-only, status-only, broad truthiness-only, or single-tool-without-setup tests do not satisfy this criterion.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Kept as a useful B-leaning quality discriminator; Opus more often preserves captured-ID and raw-body checks.
